title: ECDC — Seasonal surveillance of chikungunya virus disease in the EU/EEA

chunks.text:
Source: https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/chikungunya-monthly (EU/EEA seasonal report https://chik-weekly.ecdc.europa.eu/), retrieved 2026-07-22.
As of 2026-07-22, a cumulative total of 0 (zero) EU/EEA countries have reported locally-acquired (autochthonous) chikungunya virus disease in 2026 (year-to-date). The 2026 seasonal surveillance cycle in the EU/EEA has not yet begun (no cases entered into ECDC EpiPulse).
Note: this custom scraper renders ECDC's client-side EU/EEA seasonal surveillance report into compact HTML because the count of EU/EEA countries with locally-acquired chikungunya is injected client-side and is absent from the statically served page. The count is a cumulative year-to-date number of EU/EEA countries reporting autochthonous transmission.
